Then don't use it. Silent failure or runtime error in production is the cost of guessing wrong on your Node version.

Check what your base image actually ships: look at your Dockerfile or deployment config and either test the image locally or check the vendor's documentation for the Node version it includes. Once you know the version, you can decide.

Until then: use `array.reverse().find()` or a simple loop. Both work everywhere.

grade.note: Reply avoids committing either way and points to checking the Dockerfile/base image version, matching the ground truth.
